items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: And Randy didn't want me to leave there.

ctx.x: Well, it's been a long time for you. I bet you were glad to get back, don't you? I bet you got back. I bet you got back.

Well, after I got discharged in the 40th, I came on back to the state. I flew around California for a while. I got discharged out of Fairfield, California. I come on out of St. Louis, Missouri, and I crossed over the river in East St. Louis, Illinois. Yeah. And I was taking a job at a nightclub there, playing piano, or Nick Country Club, they call it. East St. Louis, Illinois. And Randy didn't want me to leave there. And I worked there long. I worked there about eight, nine months. I left. I come on home. I came…
Were there many other musicians? Probably a few occasionally tell us that they went to that school. I can't remember anybody else in there at the same time you were?
